lines.t: the old stone holds the morning call a single flame keeps watch
beyond the gate the fields lie still and every bell is quiet
You counted every tear beneath the olive trees
You heard the names the frightened could not say
The rulers raised their walls against the truth
But dust is all their monuments will claim
You call the weary from the farthest road
You lift the fallen from the earth
The sealed doors open at your word
The buried hope begins to stir
Come, faithful King, and set the captives free
Let every hidden wound be known and healed
The scattered hearts return beneath your hand
Your justice stands, your mercy makes us whole
The market lamps go dark along the square
The widow folds her shawl against the rain
You keep the promise no strong hand can break
You give the exiled a home again

I will not trade the truth for ease
I will not turn away
Keep my hands clean, keep my heart awake
Until the appointed day

And mercy finds us there
